No precinct-level report is listed for any of the three elections, and every file was uploaded after election night. The page keeps files back to 2020, so nothing appears to have been removed, but an election-night posting that was later removed cannot be ruled out. The Democratic primary PDF (same SOS report type) was not opened. En dashes in quoted link titles were replaced with hyphens. Runoff summary shows 'Election Day Precincts Reporting 1 of 1'.
